name: Turkey Burger with Sweet Potato Wedges
method: Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges, toss with the oil and smoked paprika and bake at 220°C for 30 minutes.
Season the turkey mince and shape into 2 big burgers; fry or grill for 6–7 minutes a side until cooked through.
Serve in toasted rolls with salad, tomato and a spoonful of Greek yogurt.
